<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1373" height="758" style="width: 1373px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Report > Report List.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="315" height="124" style="width: 315px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2.

- Use the search bar and dropdown menus to filter results to view recent records.

- Click the Excel button to download the current report data into a spreadsheet for offline analysis.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="594" height="198" style="width: 594px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
